calculation.expression: mean_3(-(log(close/close[-10]))/(sqrt(20)*rolling_std_20(log_returns))), activated when lagged cross-asset return dispersion exceeds its trailing 252-day 90th percentile
calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, calculate a volatility-normalized 10-day contrarian return and smooth it over three observations. The signal is active only on dates whose prior-day cross-sectional return dispersion is above the trailing 252-day 90th percentile. All inputs are lag-safe and use only completed daily data.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2033-02-17 available history, evaluated with 10-day forward returns
validation.regime_notes: Conditional factor has 245 valid daily cross-sectional observations and the full 15-asset universe on each valid date. Estimation uncertainty remains material because the cross-section is small; the stricter 90th-percentile gate is selective. No unsupported library-correlation value was fabricated.
